daemon_user.description: System user account under which the ipp-usb daemon runs (must exist).

daemon_group.description: System group for the ipp-usb daemon’s file permissions and access rights.

http_port.description: HTTP port for the ipp-usb daemon. Set to 0 to disable HTTP and use Unix socket only.

enable_https.description: Enable HTTPS instead of HTTP (requires valid TLS certificate and key).

ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL/TLS certificate file (PEM format), used only if HTTPS is enabled.

ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL/TLS private key file (PEM format), used only if HTTPS is enabled.

device_timeout.description: Maximum seconds to wait for a USB device to respond during detection or data transfer.

max_devices.description: Maximum number of USB printers that may be handled simultaneously.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging output (lower levels = more verbose).

debug_logging.description: Enable high-volume debug logging. Overrides LogLevel when true.

backend_paths.description: Search paths (colon-separated in rendered config) for backend helper executables.

unix_socket_path.description: Path to the Unix domain socket for local client communication.

allow_remote.description: Allow network clients (e.g., CUPS remote servers) to use the ipp-usb service.

allowed_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDR networks allowed to connect when AllowRemote is enabled.

denied_hosts.description: List of hostnames or CIDR networks explicitly denied, overriding any Allow rules.

stable_names.description: Use stable, persistent USB device paths (e.g., /dev/serial/by-id/) instead of dynamic device nodes like /dev/usb/lp0.

enable_bonjour.description: Advertise ipp-usb services via mDNS (Bonjour). Requires Avahi or compatible daemon.

bonjour_service_name.description: Human-readable service name advertised in mDNS for discovery.

extra_backend_args.description: Optional space-separated arguments passed to the backend on startup (for advanced tuning).
